Israeli Settlers Attack NBC News Crew in West Bank; Netanyahu Condemns Violence

An NBC News crew and a Palestinian woman were attacked by Israeli settlers in the West Bank village of Qusra over the weekend. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu condemned the incident, calling the settlers "extremists" and stating they "will not be forgiven." Some former Israeli generals and officials are accusing settlers of "Jewish terrorism" and ethnic cleansing, with concerns that the government may be supporting such actions. Separately, Israeli Minister Ben-Gvir and settlers were reported to have stormed the Al-Aqsa Mosque compound in East Jerusalem.
